document.title: Direct Manipulation Cleanup
document.purpose: Record the cleanup that made object manipulation direct and conventional.

summary: Object manipulation is now driven by mouse interaction. Body drag moves selected object(s), size handles scale selected object(s), rotate handles rotate selected object(s), and clicking an already-selected object toggles handle kind between size and rotate. The rotate and size chord commands were removed from command handling.

removals.rotate-command: Removed from command mapping and reducer command handling.
removals.size-command: Removed from command mapping and reducer command handling.

policy: Clicking an already-selected body toggles size and rotate handles.

interaction-distinction.body-drag: drag_selection starts from DERIVED target kind node and claims pointer:left plus selection.
interaction-distinction.rotate-drag: rotate_selection starts from DERIVED target kind handle with handle_kind rotate and claims handle:rotate.
interaction-distinction.size-drag: size_selection starts from DERIVED target kind handle with handle_kind size and claims handle:size.
interaction-distinction.marquee-drag: marquee_select starts from empty target on the canvas.
interaction-distinction.click-toggle: drag_selection toggles manipulation kind on release when the press began on an already-selected node and did not cross the drag threshold.

node.manipulation_kind: current visible manipulation kind or null

handle.handle_name: rotate, nw, ne, sw, or se

ctrl-enter-apply.behavior: The shortcut calls apply_inspector() from inspector entry and note widgets and returns break so note fields do not insert a newline.

inspector-layout.button-row: Inspector action buttons are consolidated into one compact horizontal row.
inspector-layout.behavior: The row uses the same existing callbacks and does not change command, semantic, world, or history behavior.

known-limitations: Size handles still use center-based uniform scaling.
No side handles or non-uniform scaling yet.
No snapping or constrained-angle rotation yet.
suggested-next-work: better handle styling and cursor feedback
